tasks_completed.description: Updated happy-daemon-dev.service to use dev binary directly instead of production /usr/bin/happy
tasks_completed.changes: ExecStart and ExecStop changed from /usr/bin/happy to /usr/bin/node --no-warnings --no-deprecation /root/happy-dev/packages/happy-cli/dist/index.mjs. All other lines (Environment, WorkingDirectory, etc.) preserved exactly.
tasks_completed.rationale: Dev daemon was invoking the production global binary at /usr/bin/happy which resolves to /root/happy/ source tree. This caused all Bug #62 MCP fixes applied to /root/happy-dev/ to be ignored. Direct node invocation ensures dev daemon runs dev code.

tasks_completed.description: Added Bash hook rule to block any command combining happy-daemon-dev with /usr/bin/happy
tasks_completed.changes: Added rule before force-push warning: if command contains both 'happy-daemon-dev' and '/usr/bin/happy', block with exit 2.
tasks_completed.rationale: Prevents any future Bash command from reverting the dev service to use the production binary.

tasks_completed.description: Added Write/Edit hook rule to block writing /usr/bin/happy into happy-daemon-dev.service
tasks_completed.changes: Added content-level check: when editing /etc/systemd/system/happy-daemon-dev.service, block if new_string or content contains ExecStart=/usr/bin/happy or ExecStop=/usr/bin/happy.
tasks_completed.rationale: Prevents file edits from reintroducing the production binary reference into the dev service file.

tasks_completed.description: Ran systemctl daemon-reload to apply service file changes
tasks_completed.changes: systemctl daemon-reload executed successfully. Service NOT restarted (user's session is running).
tasks_completed.rationale: daemon-reload is safe — it only re-reads unit files without affecting running services. The new ExecStart will take effect on next daemon restart.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Original service file creation used /usr/bin/happy (the global CLI binary) for convenience, not realizing this resolves to /root/happy/ production source tree
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Dev daemon service was created before the isolation architecture was established. /usr/bin/happy is a global symlink to /root/happy/ production code, so dev daemon was effectively running production code and ignoring all dev-specific fixes.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Direct node invocation of /root/happy-dev/packages/happy-cli/dist/index.mjs ensures dev daemon always runs dev code. Hook rules prevent regression.

blast_radius.note: Systemd service file, not imported by code. Affects only happy-daemon-dev service on next restart.
PreToolUse hook, executed by Claude Code harness. Affects all Bash tool invocations.
PreToolUse hook, executed by Claude Code harness. Affects all Write/Edit tool invocations.

dev.qa_notes: The service file change takes effect on next daemon restart. Do NOT restart the daemon now — the user's current session is running on it. Verify with the verification_commands below. Hook rules can be tested by attempting blocked operations (they should be rejected).
